name: Jellyfin
param_style: @name params (Microsoft.Data.Sqlite); tag v10.10.7, the last release line before the EF Core rewrite. Item SQL is concatenated at runtime by SqliteItemRepository (column list, WHERE list, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, literal LIMIT/OFFSET), so item queries are representative instantiations per caller. System.Guid binds as a 16-byte blob.
schema_source: tag v10.10.7: CREATE TABLE/INDEX strings and AddColumn ALTERs from Emby.Server.Implementations/Data/SqliteItemRepository.cs Initialize() (plus BaseSqliteRepository.cs AddColumn format) and SqliteUserDataRepository.cs; only what the queries need (GPL)
data_scale: scale 1: 4 libraries, 4k movies, 200 series / 800 seasons / 9.6k episodes, 200 artists / 800 albums / 8k tracks, 2k persons, 72 genre/studio items; ~55k ItemValues, 34k People, 73k AncestorIds, 3k UserDatas (5 users), 35k mediastreams, 32k chapters
visibility_note: ~59k stars; the most widely deployed open-source media server; SQLite (library.db) was its only database through 10.10.x
interest_note: One mega-table (TypedBaseItems, ~70 columns, 14 composite indexes) queried by a runtime SQL builder: UserDatas left joins, GROUP BY PresentationUniqueKey with bare columns, computed SearchScore/SimilarityScore columns filtered by alias, correlated ItemValues/People count subqueries, correlated subqueries as ORDER BY keys, and IN-chains through ItemValues for genre/artist pages.
